dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular and jagged light-toned perimeters forming closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' structures, characterized by a sharp pixel intensity gradient from dark exterior backgrounds to high-intensity boundaries with dark core interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-gray clusters concentrated primarily at the neck-shoulder transition and the ventral-lateral margin, featuring minimal internal gradient or texture.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an irregular trapezoidal configuration roughly aligned with the spinal axis; secondary blobs on the lower flank form a roughly linear chain of points extending posteriorly.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense micro-speckling pattern localized on the facial and cranial regions, displaying a significantly higher spatial frequency and lower contrast compared to the primary dorsal ring structures.
